title: Degree bound for resilient functions
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $k$ be a natural number. If $f$ is $k$-resilient and $k<n-1$, then the algebraic degree of its encoding as a function on the Boolean cube over the two-element field is at most $n-k-1$.
